items.description:
Deprecated (2026-11-09). Use danielrosehill/English-Hebrew-Codeswitching-Sentences instead. An early-stage collection of English sentences with Hebrew words. Its labels came from substring term matching and are unreliable; the successor is the curated code-switching set in the standard format. This repo is kept as it was so its links and DOI keep resolving; it is no longer updated.

English-Hebrew Code-Switching ASR Benchmark
	


Status (2026-10-25): test set v2 is current. It is the set Hebrish uses for its own internal benchmarks, and the one new results are scored on. Still a small, single-speaker benchmark: read the limits below before drawing conclusions. v1 (2026-10-15) stays here unchanged, with the results scored on it.
